svg.title: Piyush Raj versus a bug
svg.desc: A pixel-art battle. A developer with a git push attack fights BUG_4041 and wins. Piyush Raj is open to backend, platform and software engineering roles.

text.tspan: PIYUSH used git push -f. It’s super effective!
BUG used NullPointerException. PIYUSH took 30 damage.
